name: Boundary Palm
description: Strike with a palm held at the line where dark meets the last of the light.

name: Grey Ward
description: Raise a grey ward of half-lit dark that gives a blow nothing clean to hit.

name: Margin Step
description: Step along the margin of a shadow so the body is lit on one side and hidden on the other.

name: Edge Drift
description: Drift along a seam of dark and bright and cross a good span before the foe turns.

name: Dim Glare
description: Cast a glare that is half dark so the foe cannot tell whether he is blind or dazzled.

name: Split Hue
description: Throw a blow whose two halves come in dark and bright so the guard meets only one.

name: Dusk Seam
description: Drive a narrow seam of dusk through a guard along the line where it is weakest.

name: Held Twilight
description: Hold a long steady twilight before the body that blunts both blades and bolts of qi.

name: Veil Flash
description: Flash from one patch of dark to another across the qi field before the light can follow.

name: Twilight Edict
description: streams: Darkness + Light; hold dark and light edge to edge and let the line between them fall on the foe as a ruling.

name: Joined Palm
description: Press a palm in which a black hand and a bright hand are laid together.

name: Seam Guard
description: Meet a thrust on the seam of the joined streams so it slides off to either side.

name: Joint Turn
description: Turn on the heel between a lit and an unlit quarter and move off from whichever the foe watches.

name: Halved Sight
description: Read the room twice with one eye in the dark and one in the bright.

name: Unlit Glare
description: Hold a glare of black fire at a foe's eyes that blinds him and shows him nothing in turn.

name: Black Radiance
description: Send a ring of dark that shines at its edge and burns whatever stands on the line.

name: Pale Cloak
description: Wear a cloak of pale dark that thins to light where a blow would land and takes it.

name: Eclipse Fringe
description: Hold a foe at the fringe of an eclipse where his strength drains and returns by turns.

name: Corona Rend
description: Drive a corona of bright through the black and out the other side of the guard.

name: Core Twilight
description: Hold the twilight of the joined core as a wide shield that turns the heaviest strikes.

name: Phase Through
description: Pass through a wall of the foe's own light and shadow and stand behind it unharmed.

name: Sunless Corona
description: streams: Darkness + Light; set a crown of bright round a core of black and drop the whole on the foes.

name: Hiding Palm
description: Strike with a palm that hides the blow in dark while a thin light draws the eye away.

name: Showing Guard
description: Show the foe a bright false arm while the true arm in the dark turns the cut.

name: Echo Glide
description: Step and leave a bright echo of the body where it was while the true body goes dark.

name: Cast Double
description: Cast one bright double and one dark double about the foe so he strikes at neither true shape.

name: Hidden Shining
description: Hide a core of light inside the dark so the body strikes and guards with a hidden edge.

name: Glare Wave
description: Send out a wave that flares bright and then falls dark and stings at each change.

name: Dim Contrast
description: Flash light and dark across a foe's eyes in swift turns until his judgement of distance fails.

name: False Dawn
description: Raise a false dawn over a field of foes so they stand lit and trust a dark that is not there.

name: Shadow Truth
description: Strike the one shadow among many that is true and break the foe where he really stands.

name: Light Swallow
description: Swallow a flood of bright qi into the dark and keep it for the next strike.

name: Blinding Eclipse
description: streams: Darkness + Light; show and hide at once until every foe sees only what the user chooses.
